page.overview:
What is Planet Vegeta?

In Dragon Ball GT, Baby wishes to Ultimate Shenron for Planet Vegeta to be restored in Earth's Solar System. Upon being restored Baby renames the planet to , also called New Planet Plant or the Tuffle Planet.

It exists in Universe 6 under the name Planet Tuffle.

Planet Vegeta was not the native planet of the Saiyans, but Planet Sadala was and they only relocated to Planet Vegeta after Sadala's destruction.

A copy of Planet Vegeta exists in the Pseudo Universe.
